name: Codewhale
description: Runs a terminal coding agent with plan and work modes, approval levels, durable goals, agent teams, and MCP, using hosted or local models through Ollama, vLLM, or SGLang.

skills.name: Plan And Work Modes
skills.description: Explores read-only in plan mode, edits in work mode, and lets you pick Ask, Auto-Review, or Full Access approval levels.

skills.name: Headless Exec Runs
skills.description: Runs a task non-interactively with codewhale exec for scripts and CI, or opens the same runtime in a local web client.

skills.name: Agent Teams
skills.description: Coordinates teams of agents with roles kept as readable files in the project, without dumping their instructions into your transcript.

skills.name: GitHub PR Review
skills.description: Reviews pull requests from a GitHub Action that runs codewhale review on a pinned release, authorized by a Codewhale account key.

skills.name: Undo And Restore
skills.description: Recovers workspace changes with /undo and /restore, and saves sessions with a durable /goal so long work can resume.
